spec_match.rationale: Queries decodingInfo() with the exact spec-6.4 string space — four substream codecs (Opus, mp4a.40.2, fLaC, ipcm) at the three IA profiles 000/001/002 — plus non-IAMF baselines that make a negative answer falsifiable.

interactive.rationale: Query-type select (media-source vs file) plus a run button drive 15 real decodingInfo() calls; every cell renders the literal supported/smooth/powerEfficient answer.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises real decodingInfo() answers per codec and profile next to baselines; the page delivers exactly that table.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinct honest branches for missing mediaCapabilities, per-query rejection, IAMF-supported, IAMF-negative-with-working-baselines, and everything-negative; the verdict line names which case occurred.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry and IAMF spec section 6.4 directly.

conformance.rationale: The v153 feature suite pins the contracts the matrix relies on (resolve-not-reject, boolean answers, malformed refusal); 9/9 pass in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run against localhost:3000/v153/.../codec-probe-matrix/ (headless Chromium 141): clicking Run answered 15 of 15 queries, all 12 IAMF cells not supported, 2 of 3 baselines supported, verdict line rendered the trustworthy-negative branch; console and network clean; screenshot v153-iamf-matrix.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts iamf-matrix-ran with answered/supported counts and query type; the no-API fallback asserts iamf-matrix-fallback-no-api.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald is darkened via color-mix to hit AA at 0.9rem; the matrix table sits in an overflow-x:auto wrapper.

accessibility.rationale: Real table semantics with scoped row/column headers, labelled select, and a role=status aria-live=polite verdict line; verdicts are text, not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/immersive-audio-model-and-formats-iamf-decoding-support --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline reference links; all primary controls have min-block-size 44px); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the matrix on an IAMF-enabled Chromium and on post-flip Chrome 153 stable
openQuestions.detail: Every IAMF cell currently answers supported:false in all available browsers. When a build with ENABLE_IAMF_TOOLS + --enable-features=IamfAudioDecoding (or a Chrome 153 stable where the flip actually landed) is available, confirm which profile/codec cells flip to supported and that smooth/powerEfficient render, then refresh the page's status note if ChromeStatus moves past 'Proposed'.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async result status live region without stealing focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Deliver async outcome text through a polite live region and never rely on colour alone for state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict line is role=status aria-live=polite; each cell carries the textual verdict (supported / not supported / rejected) beside its colour.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: verdict text updated after the 15 queries without focus moves

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table small screens horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let wide tabular content scroll inside its own container instead of forcing page-level horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The 4-column matrix lives in .matrix-wrap { overflow-x: auto }; the page body never scrolls horizontally at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: responsive-check mobile pass: no horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3

summary: v153 refile of the v152 matrix (same chromestatus feature, now at its shipping-stage milestone): milestone framing updated to 'anticipated to ship in 153, still Proposed as of 2026-08-16'. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: 15/15 queries answered, honest all-negative IAMF block with 2/3 working baselines, clean console/network, both responsive classes pass.
